title: Frame and Surface Specifications — Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces Catalogue
content:
Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces catalogue specifications, by bed class: how the bed height is adjusted (fixed, manual crank or electric), how the head and foot sections are adjusted (manual crank or electric), the sleeping surface width in inches, whether a standard mattress is included in the bed payment, whether side rails are included in the bed payment, and whether the bed is assembled in the home by Summit Ridge staff.

| Bed class | Bed height adjustment | Head and foot adjustment | Sleeping surface width | Standard mattress included in the bed payment | Side rails included in the bed payment | Assembled in the home by Summit Ridge staff |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) | fixed | manual crank | 36 inches | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Variable-Height Hospital Bed (E0255) | manual crank | manual crank | 36 inches | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | manual crank | electric | 36 inches | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) | electric | electric | 36 inches | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0303) | manual crank | manual crank | 42 inches | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Extra Heavy-Duty Hospital Bed (E0304) | electric | electric | 48 inches | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Notes on the specification sheet

**Height control.** Only the Fixed-Height Hospital Bed (E0250) has a fixed height. The Variable-Height, Semi-Electric and Heavy-Duty classes adjust height by manual crank. The Total Electric and Extra Heavy-Duty classes adjust height electrically.

**Head and foot control.** The Fixed-Height, Variable-Height and Heavy-Duty classes adjust the head and foot sections by manual crank; the Semi-Electric, Total Electric and Extra Heavy-Duty classes adjust them electrically.

**Width.** Four classes share a 36-inch sleeping surface; the Heavy-Duty class is 42 inches wide and the Extra Heavy-Duty class 48 inches wide.

**Mattress, rails and assembly.** In every class a standard mattress and side rails are included in the bed payment, and every class is assembled in the home by Summit Ridge staff.

### Comparing two classes (illustration)

| Feature | Semi-Electric Hospital Bed (E0260) | Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) |
|---|---|---|
| Bed height adjustment | manual crank | electric |
| Head and foot adjustment | electric | electric |
| Sleeping surface width | 36 inches | 36 inches |

The two classes differ in this sheet only in how the bed height is adjusted.
